items.a: Cost, macros, and taste, S through D. A store on every corner can buy a letter. He is fasted, and he says that hunger flatters the quarter pounder.

Chipotle's double-protein bowl (~$18–20, 990 kcal, 79 g protein; halve it). Chick-fil-A grilled sandwich (390 kcal, 28 g, $7.24). Panda triple teriyaki (1,540 kcal, 136 g, ~450 g chicken, $16, two meals).

items.q: Why are the nuggets only an A?
items.a: 200 kcal and 38 g protein, about $9, and not dry. A snack is not a meal, and a shake is cheaper for the same macros.

Taco Bell cantina chicken is an A (109 g weighed, guac is the flavor, his stomach objects). Cane's four-finger box is a B (leg-day cheat, 1,250 kcal). Quarter pounder is a C ($6, was a D). McDonald's strips are a D (dry, 23 g, $7.20).
